definitions.gloss: returning home for the Obon festival; going back to one's hometown during Obon
definitions.explanation: The custom of returning to one's hometown during the Obon period (mid-August) to visit family and honor ancestors. One of the peak travel periods in Japan alongside New Year and Golden Week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to go home for Obon this year.

examples.japanese: {盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The Shinkansen gets crowded during the Obon homecoming period.

examples.japanese: {盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: To avoid the Obon homecoming rush, I decided to leave a day early.

notes:
USAGE:
Obon (mid-August, typically August 13-16) is one of Japan's most important holiday periods. Many people return to their hometowns to visit family graves and spend time with relatives. This causes massive traffic jams and crowded transportation, similar to ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧ (New Year homecoming).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ (Obon homecoming rush)
- {盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧ (Obon traffic jam)
- {盆|ぼん}{帰|がえ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go home for Obon)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧: homecoming — the general term for returning to one's hometown
- ⟦{里帰|さとがえ}り→里帰り：17444_satogaeri⟧: visiting one's parental home — broader, not limited to Obon
